g.text: Keep the input within ATmega328P voltage limits and join the source and Uno grounds. The simple Lab 38 subtraction requires pulse widths shorter than one 16-bit timer wrap.

g.desc: Keep the input within ATmega328P voltage limits and join the source and Uno grounds. The simple Lab 38 subtraction requires pulse widths shorter than one 16-bit timer wrap.

g.text: ERC and net checks validate this pin map; no external pulse source was physically measured.

g.text: Connect a pulse generator or another verified 0–5 V logic source to J1 pin 1 and its ground to pin 2. Uno D8 is ICP1.

g.desc: Connect a pulse generator or another verified 0–5 V logic source to J1 pin 1 and its ground to pin 2. Uno D8 is ICP1.

g.text: This connector is a test signal, not a source that should be powered from the Uno.
